limitations: This repeatability evaluation does not establish timestamp accuracy because no human timestamp gold set was used.
The five-run pinned configuration failed two pre-registered gates and cannot authorize learner-visible pronunciation, fluency, holistic or attempt scores.
The diagnostic dither=0 control isolates the observed nondeterminism trigger but is not itself the pre-registered acceptance run.
The phone tier is not evaluated as a v1 repeatability gate.
